tools.name: create_test_address
tools.description: Create a temporary echo.email address. Send one email to it from the system under test, then call wait_for_report with the returned token and key. The address dies after 10 minutes without a wait_for_report call and accepts one message.

tools.name: wait_for_report
tools.description: Wait up to timeout_s seconds (max 50) for the email sent to a test address to be analysed. Returns status waiting or received (call again), or done with a digest: score, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS, IPv6 and the failing sender requirements.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch a finished report as JSON: the digest plus every check (SPF trace, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, TLS, IPv6, images, links, unsubscribe, headers, DNS log).
